column1: # The kinds of places on the map (PoiType, in its order): name, layer, colour (RGB hex), the game map element whose
# icon stands for it (GameIconSprites) if any, then for routes a trip's half ticks, its kind of jump (Edge.Kind) and the
# setting that weighs it (RouteSource.Saving: 0 none, 1 shortcut, 2 transport, 3 canoe, 4 carpet, 5 ship).
# The game's own map icons of no type above, by the name of their key on the game's world map (without a code in
# brackets, as "Fairy ring (AIQ)"): the name the Icons panel shows and hides them by (empty: the key's), and its
# group there. Keys not listed are under "Other map icons".
